entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-20
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • JSON output formatters label the response `charset=utf-16` but write UTF-16LE without a BOM, so a conforming client decodes it as big-endian #70758
  • Blazor WebAssembly- Hot Reload does not terminate after debug session #70756
  • OpenAPI: GetOrCreateSchemaAsync drops nullability of object properties in transformers #70753
  • Honor cancellation for OutputCache waiters #70752

Closed

  • aspnetcore-browser-refresh injection doesn't respect path prefix #53454
    Backlog
  • [blazor-wasm] A cached empty or error response for a boot resource is reused forever (`force-cache`); the app never boots again, even after a hard reload #69488
    Backlog
  • Blank page and no error when injecting undefined service in InteractiveServer #52598
    Backlog
  • [Blazor] DefaultInMemoryCircuitPersistenceProvider never disposes the retention CancellationTokenSource when a persist is rejected at capacity #70418
    Backlog
  • FieldIdentifier.Create throws ArgumentException when an indexer argument is a captured long, Guid or other non-int value type #70406
    Backlog
  • Unclear error message when nesting Counter Control inside html paragraph tags #54510
    Backlog
  • Virtualize regression in .NET 11: wheel scrolling runs ahead by whole windows in a div scroller when hovering a row changes its layout #70541
    11.0.x
  • ANCM ignores 10.0.105 Site Extension, falls back to incompatible 10.0.103 native runtime (SDK 10.0.201) #66203
  • Normalize backslashes in PathDecoder #66665
  • Request Delegate Generator: handlers that differ only by a parameter's default value share one interceptor, InvalidCastException at startup #69675
    .NET 12 Planning
  • HTTP/1.1 infinite KeepAliveTimeout and RequestHeadersTimeout expire on the next heartbeat due to deadline overflow #69692
